Customer (man) | older man with grey hair and stubble, brown jacket over a dark plaid shirt, blue jeans; first appears at 00:19 walking from the back pass-through toward the counter | walks outside toward a green box truck and climbs into the cab at 01:41-01:49 | abruptly appears in the previously empty pass-through area at 00:19, vanishes from his counter stool in the 00:51-00:59 shot before reappearing at 01:00, and swaps relative left/right seating position with the waitress at 01:27

findings.description: At 00:18, the area in front of the kitchen pass-through window behind the waitress is completely empty. At the cut to 00:19—while the waitress is in the exact same position wiping the counter—the man abruptly appears already well inside the diner in front of the pass-through window walking forward.

The man is seated on the counter stool across from the coffee machine in the shots before (00:36-00:50) and after (01:00-01:08), but in the shot of that exact section of the counter and stools from 00:51 to 00:59, he is completely absent.

At 01:17, the waitress is behind the counter directly across from the man, turning toward the back while holding a plate of food with both hands. Across the cut at 01:18, she has instantaneously jumped to the far back end of the counter, already rounding the corner to the customer side, and is holding a white coffee mug instead of the plate.

From 01:21 to 01:26, the man and waitress sit side-by-side facing the counter (screen-right), with the waitress seated to the man's left (further from the camera, closer to the kitchen) looking toward him while he looks down. Across the cut at 01:27, they face the counter (now screen-left), which reverses their relative seating order along the counter: the man is in the foreground (now to the waitress's left) looking toward the camera, while the waitress is in the background (to the man's right) looking down.

At 01:49, the waitress is standing by the exterior window next to the booths watching the man get into his truck. Across the immediate cut at 01:50, she is already seated on the stool at the counter with her hand resting on the counter.

As the waitress stands up from the counter stool at 01:51 and walks to the right to go behind the counter, a second identical copy of the waitress (same face, hair bun, blue shirt, and white apron) appears behind the counter in the midground; both copies of the waitress remain simultaneously visible walking toward the back of the diner until 01:58.
